I've been saving up to build my own PC, but I don't have a job. I use a gaming laptop that I got at a huge discount. It's pretty nice for a laptop. i7 4700MQ at 2.4 GHz, 8GB DDR3, and a GeForce GT 750M. A lot of people have a problem where their GPU is bottlenecked by their CPU, but mine is the opposite. My GPU is really weak, and games like Borderlands 2 and Mirror's Edge bring it to it's knees. I like how flexible the platform in general is, even though I can't easily swap out most of my laptop's hardware. I am currently using Ubuntu 14.10 and Windows 7 in a multiboot.

My keyboard is a Cooler Master QuickFire Rapid-i with Cherry MX blues. I've recently ordered an Ergodox ez from the IndieGoGo sale. The mouse I've primarily been using is a Zowie FK1. My Nexus 5 is running the latest version of CyanogenMod. (Lollipop is so sweet)

Add me on Steam if you want to, my name there is the same as my name here.

Have a lovely evening.
